baseline: 81d5a48, exact Git blob/LFS content verification in baseline-provenance.json
known_existing_behavior: Type97Hawk Before changes the selected base clip name but the final body and weapon pose is effectively identical to Run, also in the original baseline.

rows.name: qbz95-current

rows.observations: Compact chest-height carry. Shoulder and sleeve outline remain present in sampled front/left/back views. Hands remain aligned to the receiver and foregrip. No visible M870-style shoulder collapse or abrupt elbow inversion in this sample set.

limits: Original real skin and materials rendered through Blender CPU Cycles, not browser WebGL pixels.
Nine phases per cycle and three views; no claim of every display frame or hidden microscopic mesh intersection coverage.
Upper-body framing excludes feet and crops some long barrel tips.
Hand contact errors measure configured anchors, not exhaustive finger/weapon collision.
Baseline equivalence establishes preservation, not that every old pose or artistic choice is ideal.
artifact_scope: Standalone report, summaries and 10 reviewed contact sheets. No raw frames, baked meshes, or frozen runtime snapshot included.
